message.forecast-how-2.value: That chance is spread over time by when people usually buy: a few during the trial, most in the days right after it ends, and a tail up to
days later. Someone 10 days past their trial end has used up most of their buying window, so their chance for the next 7 days is small.

message.forecast-how-3.value: The headline adds up everyone’s chances: 20 users at 10% each make 2 expected customers.
in the next 7 days is that sum; it can be a fraction because it is an average.

message.forecast-how-4.value: possible outcomes (each user buys or not, with their chance) and taking the middle 80%.
